allowed_evidence: user-supplied screenshot or text export of gated access conditions
evidence_must_have: immutable local hash when a file is retained

requirements.requirement: Complete gated repository access conditions and confirmation that academic non-commercial local analysis is permitted.
Dataset paper or methodology identifying upstream victim-report and legitimate-message sources.
Record-level source, incident, report, campaign or family identifiers sufficient for leakage-safe grouping.
PII removal, consent/public-report basis and privacy review procedure.
Independent annotation/adjudication procedure and evidence that scam labels are not created solely from the message text.
Explicit original-to-rewrite linkage and a rule keeping each original and all rewrites in one group.
Publisher file manifest, exact CSV names, sizes and checksums before acquisition.

sources.resolution_rule: All seven requirements must be independently verified before any acquisition release. Synthetic rewrites remain excluded from real-world ground truth.
sources.fallback: If record provenance or privacy/adjudication evidence cannot be obtained, reject for V1 rather than infer missing facts.

requirements.requirement: Publisher-defined investment-scam subtype, category field or documented investment subset that can be selected without relabeling messages.
Detailed annotation guide, adjudication independence and inter-annotator agreement or equivalent quality evidence.
Per-record source or contributor provenance that can be retained without exposing personal data.
Campaign, sender, template, contributor or near-duplicate family keys suitable for group-level splitting.
Immutable identification of the publisher's 597-row official test so it can remain sealed and excluded from development.
Publisher manifest and checksums for full_dataset.csv, train.csv and test.csv.
Retained CC BY 4.0 license, consent/ethics statement and PII-normalization procedure.

sources.resolution_rule: Investment-specific admission requires VS01 plus independent verification of VS02-VS07. The official test must remain sealed.
sources.fallback: If VS01 does not exist, the source may only be reconsidered under a separate general Vietnamese scam auxiliary protocol with zero fresh V1-Core credit; do not create investment labels from keyword filtering.
